netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 6)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_S1 n1 S1_am 0
R_S1 S1_am n2 0.01
vam_LA1 n2 LA1_am 0
B_LA1 LA1_am 0 I = v(LA1_am,0)/(60*(0.1+0.9*abs(v(LA1_x))))
C_LA1_x LA1_x 0 1
B_LA1_t 0 LA1_x I = (((v(LA1_am,0)*v(LA1_am,0)/(60*(0.1+0.9*abs(v(LA1_x)))))/0.6+1e-9)^0.25 - v(LA1_x))/0.15
.ic v(LA1_x)=0
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 0.001 1 0 0.001
write __OUT__ v(LA1_x) v(n1) v(n2) i(vam_b1) i(vam_s1) i(vam_la1)
quit
.endc
.end
